Depth two, its successor and terminal cell exhaust the registered muon grammar.
The exact muon anomaly is the terminal electron anomaly plus alpha^2 [2/17 + alpha/106 + alpha^2/853], with 17=2*3^2-1, 53=2*3^3-1 and 853=16*53+5.

registration.statement: The complete electron loop is universal.  The second charged-lepton generation adds the positive mass-scale correction at alpha squared: both Fold labels over the depth-two complement 17, then one alpha return over the binary-distributed depth-three complement 2 times 53, then one alpha-squared terminal cell over four-rung support 16 times 53 plus down-depth five.  This forces the exact added carrier alpha squared times [2/17 + alpha/106 + alpha squared/853].
